title: First environment audit
body:
## Goal
Measure the loop environment and write the first audit report to `audit/latest.md`.
## Acceptance
- [ ] `audit/latest.md` exists and states the measured environment facts with evidence paths
- [ ] No managed definitions are changed
## Verification
`test -f audit/latest.md`
## Context
- link: policy/roles/audit/SKILL.md - the audit role's work rules
- link: policy/working-memory.md - no iteration has been considered yet, so this is the first audit
## Budget
- policy/ and execution/ read-only; no iteration records exist yet
